name: signal_anchor
description: Covers the signal-anchor poll/anchor lifecycle: a poll snapshot ledger, an off-chain tally (simulated -- this contract deliberately doesn't tally on-chain, see contracts/signal-anchor/src/lib.rs), anchoring the result, and verifying the anchored digest. Also asserts anchor_result rejects a second call for the same poll_id (regression net for the repo's already-filed defects around this off-chain/on-chain seam: a failed anchor never retried, the results cache not invalidated after finalizing, and computeWeightedTally persisting zero voting power on RPC failure).

steps.description: simulated poll snapshot ledger -- signal-anchor has no on-chain poll state, so this just represents the ledger the off-chain tally was taken at
the off-chain weighted tally is hashed (sha256 of result_seed, standing in for the real tally payload) and anchored by the admin backend account
verify the anchored digest matches what was tallied
a second anchor attempt for the same poll_id must be rejected (AlreadyAnchored) -- an anchored result is immutable
